coordinator: Codex root; sole global progress and integration writer
previous_evidence_policy: v1 hash-only plans/checkpoints remain immutable audit evidence; never use them as complete knowledge preservation or feed them to v2. Recreate a new v2 plan from the verified original CSV.

knowledge_contract.values: Preserve exact decoded CSV strings including empty strings, newlines and full collected/self-authored rule summaries. No 240-character cutoff.
knowledge_contract.unknown_classification: UNREVIEWED with null reviewed entity type; never infer verified type from keywords
knowledge_contract.record_layer: source_record is the original knowledge layer, not an extra strategy ID
knowledge_contract.existing_reviewed_records: Keep M0256/M0259 strategy files byte-identical; source layer is additive
knowledge_contract.webpage_fulltext: Keep source links; do not fetch or reproduce full papers/webpages
knowledge_contract.recovery: From each restored batch alone, run metadata_catalog restore --kind batch and compare all eleven values/row hashes against the verified source rows; original CSV and full plan need not be available to the recovery command.
knowledge_contract.original_csv_byte_format: Not retained by decoded record recovery; preserve the original CSV separately in private backup.

batch_contract.new_collection_intake: paused until original corpus remote acceptance

publication_review.public_allowed: Complete collected catalog values and self-authored rule summaries after field review, with source links, original IDs, UNVERIFIED status and byte/hash evidence. This supersedes the old blanket prohibition on catalog rule summaries.
public_forbidden: private Library identifiers, credentials, signed URLs, local paths or personal annotations
original CSV bytes, raw market data and full source papers/webpages
private-only records or unreviewed plan inventory
publication_review.stage_bytes: Only a wholly reviewed batch with no private-only records may be copied in full and byte-identical into its allowed immutable batch directory. Verify manifest file list and every byte/hash. Never silently strip fields or adjust frozen manifest counts.
publication_review.private_only_batch: Preserve all exact values in private Library; report blocked IDs/counts without values. Do not publish a mixed private-only stage or claim public completeness. Other reviewed batches may continue after the first remote recovery gate; coordinator owns any later approved subset integration.
publication_review.private_library: Every validated batch needs its recoverable archive and independent manifest saved in the user private Library, read back and restored; report Library identities privately. Local scratch is not backup.
publication_review.public_receipts: Record safe commit/archive/manifest hashes and exact counts only; no private Library identifiers or machine paths.

handoff_per_batch: batch ID and original unique ID count
complete source records / classified records / UNREVIEWED / private-only counts separately
checkpoint manifest sha256 and exact files/bytes
private Library identity and successful readback/eleven-field restore receipt in private channel
Git branch commit and byte-identical readback receipt
publication blockers; never count local generation as remote acceptance
integration_owner: Root integrates reviewed per-ID source records and unified index serially; dot writes only this contract output root, never global progress or Site.
continue_policy: Use dot already verified CSV; do not wait for this executor Library download. Fixed tool is tested on synthetic data only until dot verifies the real CSV.
